about_the_game:
Find calm in the ordinary.

A Quiet Day is a cozy puzzle game about small, peaceful moments; from the first sip of morning tea to the quiet glow of evening light.

Solve gentle, relaxing puzzles that celebrate everyday calm, arranging small objects, finding charming clues, and piecing together tranquil scenes inspired by real life.

🍀 Wishlist today so you don't miss A Quiet Day when you need a calming experience.

What You Will Play

  • Tidy, match, sort, order and connect little objects in relaxing puzzle scenes

  • Enjoy calm gameplay with no timers, pressure, or stress - just peaceful flow

  • Watch daylight unfold through cozy environments from morning to night

  • Discover subtle stories told through wholesome, atmospheric levels

  • Unwind with soft music, ambient sounds, and warm colors designed for mindfulness

☕ In A Quiet Day, you spend a slow, gentle day solving small puzzles inspired by calm rituals and everyday moments. Rearrange, organize, and piece together a peaceful world — one soothing scene at a time.

Key Features

  • A short, heart-warming casual puzzle experience for cozy-game lovers

  • Wholesome, calming atmosphere

  • Inspired by calm moments and creative play - perfect for a quiet break

  • Ideal for fans of A Little to the Left, Unpacking, Botany Manor, and Tiny Room Stories

A Quiet Day began as a small experiment to slow down — a way to turn peaceful daily moments into interactive memories.

We believe even simple, everyday actions can feel magical when seen through a cozy lens.

Hope you enjoy your cozy ride and join us in celebrating puzzles telling stories.

Follow for our updates on A Quiet Day, and other upcoming Pocket Bat titles.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device
